description: Provides classical and statistical pattern recognition principles, Bayesian decision theory, parametric and non-parametric classifiers, and feature extraction techniques.
learning_objectives: Formulate Bayesian decision theory, discriminant functions, and Bayes risk minimization.
Perform maximum likelihood parameter estimation and Expectation-Maximization for mixture models.
Implement non-parametric estimation, linear discriminants, and Support Vector Machines.
Apply unsupervised clustering and dimensionality reduction methods.
outline: Bayesian Decision Theory: Classifiers, discriminant functions, decision surfaces, normal density, Bayes risk minimization.
Parameter Estimation: Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Bayesian parameter estimation, Expectation-Maximization (EM), Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM).
Non-Parametric Techniques: Parzen windows, k-Nearest Neighbor (k-NN) classification.
Linear Discriminants: Perceptron, Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Fisher's linear discriminant, Support Vector Machines (SVM).
Feature Engineering: Feature selection (wrapper/filter), PCA, Kernel PCA, ICA.
Clustering: K-means, Hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, Spectral clustering.

books.title: Pattern Classification
books.author: Richard O. Duda, Peter E. Hart, David G. Stork
